# Contributing to Bloodborne Legendary Run

[Français](../CONTRIBUTING.md) · **English**

Feedback in French and English is welcome. Check [existing issues](https://github.com/LINDECKER-Charles/Bloodborne-Legendary-Run-public/issues?q=is%3Aissue) and [discussions](https://github.com/LINDECKER-Charles/Bloodborne-Legendary-Run-public/discussions) before starting a new topic. If there’s already a thread about your feedback, add your observations there.

| What you want to share | Where to go |
| --- | --- |
| A screen freezes or an action gives an unexpected result | [Report a bug](https://github.com/LINDECKER-Charles/Bloodborne-Legendary-Run-public/issues/new?template=04-bug-en.yml) |
| An entry, objective, or guide contains an error | [Request a correction](https://github.com/LINDECKER-Charles/Bloodborne-Legendary-Run-public/issues/new?template=05-correction-en.yml) |
| You have a specific request to improve the companion | [Suggest an improvement](https://github.com/LINDECKER-Charles/Bloodborne-Legendary-Run-public/issues/new?template=06-suggestion-en.yml) |
| You have a question about using the app | [Discussions · Q&A](https://github.com/LINDECKER-Charles/Bloodborne-Legendary-Run-public/discussions/categories/q-a) |
| You want to discuss an idea or share a run | [Ideas](https://github.com/LINDECKER-Charles/Bloodborne-Legendary-Run-public/discussions/categories/ideas) or [Show and tell](https://github.com/LINDECKER-Charles/Bloodborne-Legendary-Run-public/discussions/categories/show-and-tell) |
| Your report involves private data or a vulnerability | [Support](SUPPORT.md) or the [security policy](SECURITY.md) |

## Write your feedback

- Open one topic per problem or request. Give it a descriptive title.
- For a bug, include the screen, platform, version if known, steps to reproduce, and what you expected.
- For a correction, link the entry or name the star. Point to the relevant passage and include a source if you have one.
- For an improvement, explain what you’re trying to do and in what situation.
- Hide email addresses, private identifiers, and account details in screenshots. Keep full save files and raw logs out of public threads. Mark major story or gameplay spoilers.

Follow your topic for replies. If a maintainer asks for more information, reply in the same thread. See the [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) for community guidelines.
